id: title:cat-ph:add issue search and linear attachments to providers

review.posthog_relevance: Adds input validation and error handling to Linear, Jira, and GitHub issue creation workflows, potentially preventing PostHog from persisting references to issues or attachments that failed to create, thereby reducing the risk of broken links or invalid issue references in the PostHog UI.
review.reason: The chunk demonstrates substantive, bounded improvements: P1.F1.H1 adds checks for GraphQL errors and missing issue IDs before raising ValidationError; P1.F1.H2 adds checks for attachment creation success; P1.F1.H3 adds HTTP status and response body checks for Jira. These are not just documentation or tests, but implementation of checks that could prevent invalid state persistence.
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the complete implementation of the new search_issues or create_attachment methods, so the full behavior and potential broader impact are not demonstrated. The benefit is inferred from the added checks rather than the complete workflow. No release notes or adoption metrics are available.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the complete implementation of the new search_issues methods for Linear, Jira, GitHub, and GitLab, nor the complete implementation of the create_attachment and search_issues methods for Linear. observations.behavior: Adds a check for GraphQL errors and missing issue identifiers before raising ValidationError, and adds a best-effort attachment attempt with its own error handling.
observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent PostHog from persisting a reference to a Linear issue that was never created, potentially causing confusion or broken links in the PostHog UI.

observations.behavior: Adds a check for GraphQL errors and missing attachment success before raising ValidationError, and adds a new search_issues method for Linear.
observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent PostHog from persisting a reference to a Linear attachment that was never created, potentially causing confusion or broken links in the PostHog UI.

observations.behavior: Adds a new search_issues method for Jira, including checks for missing cloud_id and token validity, and checks for HTTP status code and response body before raising ValidationError.
observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent PostHog from persisting a reference to a Jira issue that was never created, potentially causing confusion or broken links in the PostHog UI.
